content:
maria_ops: Heads up — we had two ~12min tail-latency spikes in apac-east this morning during the 03:00 JST traffic surge. Grafana shows token tail P99 jumped from 90ms -> 1.2s.
raj_pooleng: ugh. any autoscaler events?
sophie_sre: saw queue depth climb and a matching drop in batching efficiency. looks like batches shrank to 1-2 tokens for some requests.
infra-bot: [alert] apac-east: inference-tail-latency.p99 > 800ms (03:05..03:17) — triggered 2x — noiseless window 600s.
kevin_net: network churn noted at 03:03 — several nodes reported transient egress error 502 to internal registry for image pull. might be related.
maria_ops: timeline: spike starts 03:02, autoscaler begins provisioning GPUs 03:03, first pods ready 03:10, tail recovers 03:14. long cold-start gap.
raj_pooleng: sounds like warm-pool starvation + image-pull slowdown. our warm pool size is 2 in apac-east, recent demand doubled.
olivia_obs: prometheus query for queue depth we looked at:
```
sum(rate(queue_length[2m])) by (cluster)
```
shows a 4x bump at 03:02. also dashboard panel 'batch_size.avg' shows median batch size drop from 24 -> 3.
sophie_sre: reduced batch size = more per-token overhead -> costs spike + higher p99. need both short-term mitigation and long-term fix.
maria_ops: short-term: increase warm-pool count by 3 for apac-east, and temporarily raise min replicas on the GPU ASG. anyone opposed?
raj_pooleng: ok for short-term. but need deploy automation to scale warm pool based on recent 1h QPS. manual += 😬
kevin_net: we should also add retry/backoff for registry pulls and mirror critical images in the apac registry. that will cut image pull failure tail.
olivia_obs: can we tune alerting? current tail alert fires too late — it's after scale-up already. propose a queue-depth-derived early-warning: alert when queue_length > 70th_percentile_for_hour * 1.5 for 2m.
sophie_sre: +1. create a composite alert that triggers on (queue growth OR batch shrink OR image-pull-errors) so we get earlier ops run.
raj_pooleng: long-term: autoscaler config needs faster scale-up for GPU pools — lower stabilizationWindow + enable warm-pool auto-scheduler. also pre-pull images to node init.
maria_ops: action items: 1) raj to bump warm-pool + set temporary min replicas (done by 03:30) 2) kevin to schedule image mirror + backoff change 3) olivia to add queue-derived early alert + batch_size shrink rule 4) sophie to draft runbook update for apac cold-start incident.
raj_pooleng: will open PR for warm-pool autoscaling and warm-image prefetch playbook.
kevin_net: I'll start registry mirror job and add retry middleware config. ETA 6h.
olivia_obs: adding the alert now — testing in staging. query I used:
```
max_over_time(queue_length[5m]) > (quantile_over_time(0.7, queue_length[1h]) * 1.5)
```
will push as a temp rule.
sophie_sre: remember to add a panel showing 'image_pull_failures' to the headroom dashboard so we can correlate in next incident.
maria_ops: thanks team. i'll post a brief incident note for oncall and mark follow-ups in the retro board. :memo: 
raj_pooleng: FYI — cost note: warm-pool bump will add ~0.7 GPU-hours/hr during low traffic, anticipate small bill blip; we'll revert after autoscale tuning.
maria_ops: ok closing loop. will ping when warm-pool and alerts are live. :thumbsup:
